αἰγείῳ: αἴγειος — of a goat; masc. dat. sg. (ἀσκῷ αἰγείῳ ’goatskin bag’)
αἰδοῖός: αἰδοῖος — worthy of respect, reverend, august; masc. nom. sg., predicate adj. agreeing with the implied ’you’ (subject of εἰλήλουθας), not itself a vocative form: ’honored’ · also masc. nom. sg., predicate adj. agreeing with a first-person subject: ’revered’ (δεινός τ’ αἰδοῖός τε … τετύγμην)
αἴσχεα: αἶσχος — disgrace, shame, shameful thing; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic αἴσχη)
αἶα: αἶα — earth, land (poetic, = γαῖα); fem. nom. sg.
βήσετο: βαίνω — go, step; mixed aor. mid. 3 sg. (aor. stem βησ- with impf. endings), unaugmented: ’went’; with ἀνά in tmesis ’mounted’
βροτὸς: βροτός — mortal, as opposed to a god; masc./fem. nom. sg.
γέροντα: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. acc. sg.
γεραιός: γεραιός — old; masc. nom. sg., often substantival: ’old man’
γύναι: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. voc. sg.: ’wife’ · also fem. voc. sg., plain address to a woman who is not a wife: ’woman’ (χαῖρε, γύναι ’be glad, woman’)
δίφρον: δίφρος — chariot-platform, chariot; masc. acc. sg. · also stool, seat (of the carver’s seat) · also δίφρος — stool, seat; masc. acc. sg. (δίφρον καταθεὶς ’setting down a stool’)
δεινός: δεινός — dread, awe-inspiring, formidable; masc. nom. sg., predicate adj.
δοιὼ: δοιώ — two; numeral, dual (indeclinable, used with a dual noun)
δόλους: δόλος — guile, trick, cunning device; masc. acc. pl.
δύναμαι: δύναμαι — be able, can; pres. 1 sg.
εἴπ: εἶπον (aor. of λέγω/φημί) — say, tell; aor. imper. 2 sg., elided (εἴπ’ = εἰπέ)
εὐρέας: εὐρύς — broad, wide; masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic εὐρεῖς)
κάστορά: Κάστωρ — Castor, brother of Polydeuces; masc. acc. sg.
καλέουσιν: καλέω — call; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic καλοῦσι(ν))
καταβῆναι: καταβαίνω — go down, come down; aor. inf. act.
κεῖται: κεῖμαι — lie; pres. 3 sg., used of the dead: ’lies (dead)’ · also in the idiom θεῶν ἐν γούνασι κεῖται: ’rests with the gods, lies in the gods’ hands’ (of an outcome, not of the dead) · also subj. (= κέηται): ’should lie’ · also plain pres. 3 sg. of stored objects: ’lies, is kept/stored’ (κειμήλια κεῖται ’treasures lie stored’) · also pres. 3 sg. of a living person in a settled, ongoing state, not of the dead nor of an outcome nor of stored goods (ὁ μὲν ἐν νήσῳ κεῖται ’πάσχων’): ’remains, is stranded, dwells on’ · also of a place, ’lies, is situated’ (νῆσος ... κεῖται ’an island lies’) · also of an object: ’lies’ (ἀράχνια κεῖται ἔχουσα ’lies holding cobwebs’) · also of the spirit or heart, ’lies sunk (in)’: κεῖται ἐν ἄλγεσι θυμός ’the spirit lies in pains’
κλαίουσα: κλαίω — weep, cry; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’weeping’
κρήτεσσι: Κρής — a Cretan; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic Κρησί): ’among the Cretans’
κρητῆρα: κρητήρ — mixing-bowl (for wine and water); masc. acc. sg.
κυνώπιδος: κυνῶπις — dog-faced, dog-eyed, shameless (Helen’s self-reproach); adj., fem. gen. sg. · also of a bride, Aphrodite: κυνώπιδος … κούρης ’the shameless girl’
κύπελλα: κύπελλον — cup, drinking-vessel; neut. acc. pl.
λαερτιάδης: Λαερτιάδης — son of Laertes (patronymic of Odysseus); masc. nom. sg.
λακεδαίμονι: Λακεδαίμων — Lacedaemon, the Spartan land; fem. dat. sg., locative: ’in Lacedaemon’
λιγέως: λιγύς — clear-toned, clear-voiced; adv. λιγέως: ’clearly, in a ringing voice’
λιποῦσα: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’leaving’; with κατά in tmesis (κατὰ … λιποῦσα = καταλιποῦσα)
μάχην: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. acc. sg., cognate acc. with ἐμάχοντο: ’fought a fight’
μήδεα: μῆδος — counsel, plan, device; neut. acc. pl. μήδεα · also the genitals (of the body): περὶ χροῒ μήδεα φωτός ’the man’s genitals, about the skin’; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl. (same form), subject: ’counsels’ (σά τε μήδεα … ἀπηύρα)
μία: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; fem. nom. sg.
μεγάλην: μέγας — great, mighty; fem. acc. sg.
μεταλλᾷς: μεταλλάω — inquire after, ask about; pres. 2 sg.
μυθησαίμην: μυθέομαι — speak, tell, recount; aor. opt. 1 sg. mid., potential with κεν: ’I could tell’
μύθοισιν: μῦθος — word, speech; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
νέονται: νέομαι — go, come, return; pres. 3 pl., with future sense: ’will come back’
οἰῶν: ὄϊς (Attic οἶς) — sheep; masc./fem. gen. pl., contracted (= epic ὀίων)
οὐχ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a rough breathing (οὐχ)
οὔνομα: ὄνομα — name; neut. acc. sg., epic οὔνομα (= Attic ὄνομα)
οὗτός: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic ποτε: ’this man’
πήξας: πήγνυμι — fix, plant, make fast; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having planted’
παριστάμενος: παρίστημι — set beside; mid. stand beside, approach; pres. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.: ’standing beside’
πατρίδι: πατρίς — of one’s fathers, native; adj., fem. dat. sg., agreeing with γαίῃ: ’native (land)’
παῦρα: παῦρος — few, little; neut. acc. pl., object of δόσαν: ’very little’
πελώριος: πελώριος — monstrous, huge; masc. nom. sg.
πεπνυμένος: πέπνυμαι — have one’s wits about one, be prudent; perf. part. masc. nom. sg. (trad. linked to πνέω ’breathe’, though uncertain), stock epithet: ’prudent’
περικαλλέα: περικαλλής — very beautiful; fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic περικαλλῆ) · also neut. nom./acc. pl., agreeing with a neuter plural noun: ’very beautiful’ (ἔργα ... περικαλλέα ’very beautiful works, fine handiwork’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with δίφρον: ‘very fair (stool)’
πολυδεύκεα: Πολυδεύκης — Polydeuces; masc. acc. sg., epic -εα (= Attic -η)
πυκνά: πυκνός — thick, close-set, dense; neut. acc. pl.
πόλλ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl., elided (πόλλ’ = πολλά): ’many’ · also used adverbially: ‘much, often’ (πόλλ’ ἐπέεσσιν ‘again and again with words’) · also neut. nom. pl., attributive: ’many’ (ἤματα πόλλ’ ’many days’)
πὺξ: πύξ — with the fist, in boxing; adv. (grave accent mid-clause)
τανύπεπλος: τανύπεπλος — long-robed; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Helen (τανύ- ’long’ + πέπλος ’robe’) · also epithet of Lampetie, a daughter of the Sun
τρίτον: τρίτος — third; ordinal numeral, neut. nom. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masc. noun: τρίτον ἄνδρα ’a third man’ (as direct object) · also neut. acc. sg., direct object: τρίτον ἦμαρ ’the third day’ (τέλεσ’ Ἠώς ’Dawn completed the third day’) · also with the article, neut. acc. sg. adverbial: τὸ τρίτον ’the third time, thirdly’
υἱέϊ: υἱός — son; masc. dat. sg., epic υἱέϊ (= Attic υἱῷ)
φέρε: φέρω — bring, carry; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφερε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg. (same form): φέρε χηλὸν ’bring the chest’
φαίης: φημί — say, assert; pres. opt. 2 sg., potential with κε: ’you would say’
φαεινὸν: φαεινός — shining, bright (cf. φαίνω ’show, shine’); adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with κρητῆρα
φυσίζοος: φυσίζοος — life-giving; fem. nom. sg., with αἶα
φυὴν: φυή — stature, growth, form; fem. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’in stature’
φωτὶ: φώς — man, mortal; masc. dat. sg.
χθονὸς: χθών — earth, ground; fem. gen. sg.
χρύσεια: χρύσεος — golden; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσᾶ)
ἀγασσάμεθ: ἀγάομαι (ἄγαμαι) — wonder at, be astonished; aor. mid. 1 pl., elided (ἀγασσάμεθ’ = ἀγασσάμεθα), doubled σ
ἀγγελίης: ἀγγελίη — message, tidings, bidding; fem. gen. sg. (Ionic η)
ἀγρομένοισιν: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; aor. mid. part., syncopated (ἀγρόμενος), masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν: ’to those gathered’
ἀμείβετο: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented
ἀμφότερον: ἀμφότερος — both; neut. acc. sg., adverbial: ’in both ways, on both counts’
ἀνείρεαι: ἀνείρομαι — ask, inquire; pres. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic -ῃ)
ἀντιθέοιο: ἀντίθεος — godlike; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀρούρης: ἄρουρα — ploughed land, field; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας); ἄχθος ἀρούρης ‘a burden on the land’
ἀσκῷ: ἀσκός — skin, wineskin; masc. dat. sg.
ἐδάην: δάω — learn, get to know; aor. pass./dep. 1 sg., augmented, root δα-: ’I have learned’
ἐθέλουσι: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. 3 pl.
ἐκέλευσε: κελεύω — bid, order, command; aor. 3 sg., + inf.
ἐκγεγαυῖα: ἐκγίγνομαι — be sprung from, be born of; perf. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’sprung (from)’
ἐμὸς: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. nom. sg. · also the nominative form used as a vocative, agreeing with γαμβρός: ’my (son-in-law)!’
ἐνώμα: νωμάω — handle, wield, ply; impf. 3 sg.: ’was handling’
ἐξείνισσα: ξεινίζω (Attic ξενίζω) — entertain as a guest; aor. 1 sg. act., augmented, epic double σ (= Attic ἐξένισα)
ἐοικότα: ἔοικα — be like, be fitting; perf. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’fitting’ (ἐοικότα μυθήσασθαι ’to speak fittingly’) · also neut. nom./acc. pl., substantival: ’fitting things’ (ἐοικότα γὰρ καταλέξω ’for I will tell fitting things’) · also neut. nom. pl., predicative: ’like, comparable’ (ἐοικότα τοῖσι ’like those’) · also masc. acc. sg., ’like, resembling’ (τινά … ἐοικότα ’anyone resembling’)
ἐπίθοντο: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey; aor. mid. 3 pl., augmented (unaugmented πίθοντο): ’they obeyed’
ἐπιτροχάδην: ἐπιτροχάδην — glibly, fluently, ’at a run’; adv.
ἐρίσσειε: ἐρίζω — vie, contend; aor. opt. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐρίσειε), + dat., potential with ἄν: ’could rival’
ἐρατεινήν: ἐρατεινός — lovely, charming; fem. acc. sg.
ἐρατεινῆς: ἐρατεινός — lovely, desirable; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ῆς, epic-only word
ἑλένη: Ἑλένη — Helen, wife of Menelaus; fem. nom. sg.
ἑπόμην: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 1 sg. mid. (= Attic εἱπόμην): ’I followed’
ἑταίρους: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. pl.
ἔνι: ἐν — in; prep. + dat., postpositive with anastrophe, accent thrown back after its noun (δήμῳ ἔνι = ἐν δήμῳ) · also = ἔνεστι, ἔνεισι (ἔνι with no case): ’there is, there are in it/among them’ (ἄνδρες νηῶν ἔνι τέκτονες ’men, shipwrights, are among them’)
ἔσκε: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, iterative: ’used to be, was’
ἤλυθε: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., epic by-form (= ἦλθε): ‘he came’
ἰδέειν: ὁράω (aor. stem εἰδ-) — see; aor. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἰδεῖν)
ἰδέσθαι: ὁράω — see; aor. mid. inf.: ‘to see’ · also aor. mid. inf. of respect after θῆκεν: ’to look upon’ (μείζονα … θῆκεν ἰδέσθαι ’made taller to look upon’)
ἰδόντες: ὁράω — see; aor. part. masc. nom. pl., unaugmented: ’having seen’
ἱππόδαμον: ἱππόδαμος — horse-taming; masc. acc. sg., with Κάστορα
ἵκοιτο: ἱκνέομαι — come to, arrive at, reach; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., wish/potential: ’might come, may he reach’
ὀδυσῆΐ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. dat. sg., single-σ metrical variant Ὀδυσῆΐ (= Ὀδυσσῆϊ), dat. of the person affected: ’for Odysseus’
ὁμηλικίην: ὁμηλικίη — age-group, those of the same age, contemporaries; fem. acc. sg., acc. of respect
ὁπότε: ὁπότε — whenever, when; temporal conj., + opt. in a general/iterative clause · also + subj. without κε, of an expected event: ’when’ (ὁπότε … κρίνηται ’when the fight is decided’)
ὄρσεο: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rise, bestir oneself; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic (= Attic ὄρσο): ’get up!’
ὄχθας: ὄχθη — bank, shore; fem. acc. pl.
ὕστερος: ὕστερος — later, last (comparative); masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’later, behind’
ὕφαινον: ὑφαίνω — weave, hence devise, contrive; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’were weaving, were devising’
ὧδ: ὧδε — so, thus, in this way; adv., elided (ὧδ’ = ὧδε)
ῥίγησεν: ῥιγέω — shudder, shiver (with dread); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐρρίγησεν) (root of ῥῖγος ’cold, frost’)
